title: Understanding BLOOM: An empirical study on diverse NLP tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing model accuracy and zero-shot performance across different languages (e.g., English, German, Japanese) using multilingual benchmark datasets like XNLI and MARC to identify disparities and the impact of tokenization effects.

Generating text using the RealToxicityPrompts dataset and evaluating the outputs with the Detoxify package to measure the 'identity attack' metric, which quantifies toxic language targeting specific identity groups.
